def drive(me, enemy, arena):
    # Simple pursuit: turn toward enemy, go forward when roughly aligned
    angle = me.bearing_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)  # degrees, -180..180
    # Turn speed proportional to angle
    turn = max(-1.0, min(1.0, angle / 45.0))
    # Forward throttle reduced when turning sharply
    forward = max(0.0, 1.0 - abs(turn) * 0.5)
    left = forward + turn
    right = forward - turn
    # Clamp
    left = max(-1.0, min(1.0, left))
    right = max(-1.0, min(1.0, right))
    return (left, right)

def weapons(me, enemy, arena):
    # Keep the front spinner at max RPM

    cmd.append(spin("front", 5000))

def drive(me, enemy, arena):
    # Aim the front at the opponent and drive straight at it
    angle = bearing_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)          # -180 .. 180, left positive
    # Proportional steering, limited to full throttle
    turn = max(-1.0, min(1.0, angle / 30.0))

    forward = max(0.0, 1.0 - abs(turn) * 0.3)
    left  = forward + turn
    right = forward - turn
    left  = max(-1.0, min(1.0, left))
    right = max(-1.0, min(1.0, right))
    return (left, right)
